title: Russia Launches Massive Drone-Missile Strike on Ukraine
detail: Russian forces launched one of April's largest combined strikes: 47 missiles and 619 drones against Ukraine overnight April 24–25, primarily targeting Dnipro City and Dnipropetrovsk Oblast. At least 6 civilians were killed and 47 wounded across eight Ukrainian regions. It was the fourth strike of over 500 combined strike vehicles in April 2026, reflecting an intensified pace of long-range bombardment. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted the majority of the projectiles but could not prevent all impacts.

title: Ukraine Strikes Deep into Russia: Yekaterinburg and Chelyabinsk Targeted
detail: Ukrainian forces conducted drone strikes against Yekaterinburg, Sverdlovsk Oblast, and Chelyabinsk City — approximately 1,600–1,700 kilometers from the international border — marking some of Ukraine's longest-range drone strikes against Russia in the war. The strikes demonstrated Ukraine's growing deep-strike capability using domestically developed long-range drones, reaching into Russia's industrial Ural region for the first time.
